comment: TableEditor conformance timeline. Rest captures sit at least 0.5 s after the action that precedes them. The delete (t=1.20, .fade) and insert (t=2.20, .automatic) each have a mid-flight capture at +0.15 s. swipe-actions is omitted: UIKit has no public programmatic reveal of UIContextualAction. Same file drives Tools/oracle2/confprobe (real UIKit) and `openhost --app TableEditor` (the port).
